leadText: You and Me (Korean: 너와 나 Neowa Na) is the ending theme for the Korean dub of Mewtwo Returns. It uses the same footage from the Japanese ending To My Best Friend.
plainText:
You and Me (Korean: 너와 나 Neowa Na) is the ending theme for the Korean dub of Mewtwo Returns. It uses the same footage from the Japanese ending To My Best Friend.

==Synopsis==
 and walk across a field at dusk. They stop momentarily to watch the sunset, then turn and smile at each other before continuing on their way. Pikachu jumps onto Ash's back and begins riding on his head. As they pass by a tree they pause to watch a flock of fly overhead before walking off into the sunset.

====Humans====

====Pokémon====

(flock)

==Lyrics==
 
! Korean
! English

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
You are my best friend
 
 
 

My friend is always by my side
Whenever I felt lonely on the road I travelled alone
We sang uplifting songs together
Whether times were joyful or difficult
For the dream you and I have
We became each other's strength
The only one in the world, and so precious
You are my best friend
Like the blue stars in the sky
We will shine together, forever
Shine, forever 

 
 

zh:超夢重現 風雲再起 韓語片尾曲
